verdict.rationale: Airweave's docs describe syncing structured data from apps/databases and cloud drives (Slack, GitHub, Google Drive, Notion) into searchable collections, but no evidence shows direct ingestion of images, PDFs, or arbitrary files as memory inputs, nor multimodal parsing/recall of such files. missing for 10: explicit file/image/PDF upload API, multimodal parsing or OCR capability, and any documentation or example of recalling content from a stored image/PDF.
